runs.summary: 2 new candidates found (Delivery Hero, Valmet), 4 status changes (Bayer, BP, Voya, Disney)

newCandidates.note: Aspex Management (~9.2% stake) forced founder-CEO Niklas Östberg's resignation (announced May 12 2026); pushing for exits from non-core markets (Asia/MENA/LatAm); first divestment already done — Taiwan ops sold to Grab for $600M. Stock -30% YoY to ~€5B mkt cap. Closest analogue on the list to SOLV/VOYA-style escalating pressure.

Board launched a formal strategic review July 24 2026 to evaluate separating Process Performance Solutions from Biomaterial Solutions and Services into two standalone Nasdaq Helsinki companies. Unusual — management/board-initiated, not activist-forced. Update due with FY2026 results (~Feb 2027).

statusChanges.change: Missouri court set to hold a hearing Aug 19 2026 for final approval of the $7.25B Roundup class settlement — next hard catalyst date following the June 25 SCOTUS win. Still no formal 3-way split announcement.

Castrol 65% stake sale to Stonepeak (~$10B EV, ~$6B net proceeds) progressing toward a year-end 2026 close, part of Elliott's push for $20B of divestitures by 2027. Still asset-by-asset sales, not a structural spinoff.
Informal takeover interest surfacing, including reported interest from Principal Financial (Semafor, Jul 16 2026). No talks ongoing; board/management not yet seeking a deal.
Downgraded to ⚪ thesis-weakening/dormant — new CEO Josh D'Amaro explicitly ruled out an ESPN spinoff in July 2026, confirming ESPN stays inside Disney. No activist stake ever materialised.

content.recommendation: Run /market-analyst DHER (Delivery Hero) — activist-forced CEO exit plus a completed $600M divestment is meaningfully further along than a typical new watch-list entry.
